ability.name: Host Discovery Sweep
ability.description: Performs an ICMP and TCP ping sweep of the local subnet to identify active hosts.

stages.command_template: if not exist C:\Windows\Temp\bas mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\bas && nmap -sn -PE -PP -PS21,22,80,443,445,3389 -PA80,443,3389 -oA C:\Windows\Temp\bas\nmap_hostsweep 192.168.187.0/24

rationale: Performs a lightweight ping sweep of the target subnet to identify active hosts without triggering heavy port scans.
